Name: Peacocks
Author: StarDoodle
Description: This mod changes blue chicks and chickens into peacocks.  The blue chicks are brown to resemble actual peacock chicks.  I'm aware male peacocks don't lay eggs, but this is Stardew Valley.  Remember to backup your original files before replacing them with these.
